verdict.rationale: YPOG publishes German formation materials: a GmbH/UG foundation questionnaire and a GmbH-foundation starter kit. It also runs a webinar contrasting German venture deals with other jurisdictions. That gives thin first-party published support for the German GmbH/UG part of entity choice, while the Langdock seat relocation shows advisory work rather than published guidance. Missing for 10: published guidance comparing entity types and incorporation jurisdictions (Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, Indian Pvt Ltd), market-based selection criteria, evidence that the starter kit explains GmbH vs UG choice, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes guidance on choosing entity type and jurisdiction of incorporation (Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, German GmbH/UG, Indian Pvt Ltd) appropriate to my market
